profile.summary: A nonprofit based in Oakland, California, that uses rap music creation and hip-hop culture as a form of therapy to connect young people to mental health services. It serves youth and young adults of color and other marginalized young people, including those in foster care or the juvenile justice system. It also runs the BRL Academy and trains service providers.
